clue.text: Soft and undemanding quandary

parts.note: P is piano, the musical abbreviation for soft
light work is undemanding work

explanation.surface: Someone is stuck in an easy-going but awkward predicament.
explanation.definitionFit: A sorry predicament or dilemma is a synonym for a quandary.

clue.text: Man's armour is returned

indicators.note: returned signals that the word for armour is read backwards

parts.note: chain mail is armour

explanation.surface: A knight's armour is sent back to him.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's stands for 'is': the name is the armour word read backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Liam is a common boy's given name, so it is an example of a man's name.

clue.text: Wrong dupe blown up by it?

definitions.text: Wrong dupe blown up by it?

indicators.note: letters blown up are scattered and land in a new order

explanation.surface: A deceived victim is wrongly blasted by an explosive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blown up' rearranges the nine letters of WRONG DUPE; the whole clue also defines the explosive that blows people up.
explanation.definitionFit: The black explosive powder is what would blow up a victim, so the whole clue describes it.

clue.text: "Lofty" is a master of polyphony

parts.note: lofty means tall
taken as written

explanation.surface: A man nicknamed Lofty is a great composer.
explanation.walkthrough: Thomas Tallis was a Tudor English composer of many-voiced church music.
explanation.definitionFit: Tallis wrote elaborate many-voiced choral works, making him a renowned composer of polyphony.

clue.text: Cook's equipment, say, starts to get swamped by vermin

parts.note: EG, for example, is signalled by 'say'

indicators.note: the starts of the words get and swamped give their opening letters

parts.note: lice are parasitic vermin

explanation.surface: A cook's kitchen is overrun with pests.
explanation.definitionFit: A slotted kitchen tool for lifting fried eggs is a piece of a cook's equipment.

clue.text: Willingly undertaking to bend ear and reel punter in

indicators.note: bending the words twists their letters into a new order

explanation.surface: A salesman eagerly bends a gambler's ear and reels him in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to bend' rearranges EAR, REEL, PUNTER and IN together, fifteen letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Being enterprising means readily taking on new business ventures, a willingness to undertake.

clue.text: Foster parent squashed iguana crossing road

indicators.note: the rearranged lizard letters straddle the road abbreviation, which sits inside them
squashed means crushed out of shape, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A foster parent comes upon an iguana flattened on the road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'squashed' rearranges the lizard into GUAIAN; 'crossing' means those letters span the road abbreviation. The road-kill picture hides a legal guardian.
explanation.definitionFit: A guardian is legally responsible for a child in place of parents, as a foster parent is.

clue.text: Straight thinking required of soldier during Passover

indicators.note: during places the soldier within the turned pass
over signals that the word for a mountain pass is turned round

parts.note: a col is a mountain pass
GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: Clear reasoning is demanded of a soldier at the Jewish festival.
explanation.walkthrough: The festival name must be split: its first half is the mountain pass, turned round by 'over' to give LOC, and 'during' holds the soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: Logic is rigorous reasoning, the very essence of straight thinking.

clue.text: Abundance of grain about to replace model in ideal world

parts.note: corn is grain

indicators.note: the circa letter takes the place of the model letter

parts.note: Utopia is an imagined perfect world
T as in the Model T Ford
C is circa, about

explanation.surface: A heap of grain in a perfect world.
explanation.walkthrough: In UTOPIA, 'to replace' swaps T for C, giving UCOPIA.
explanation.definitionFit: The horn of plenty is a symbol of overflowing abundance.

clue.text: Haggard's permitted token of defiance

parts.note: haggard means gaunt; the 's is 'is'
let means permitted

explanation.surface: A careworn figure is allowed to make a gesture of defiance.
explanation.definitionFit: Throwing down a glove was the traditional token of defiance or challenge.

clue.text: Goat's new in the marketplace

indicators.note: the new letter goes inside the market word

parts.note: the agora was the marketplace of ancient Greek cities

explanation.surface: A goat is a new arrival at market.
explanation.definitionFit: The Angora is a breed of goat prized for its mohair fleece.

clue.text: Throwaway line in dim but erotic performance

indicators.note: a performance of the words puts their letters through a new routine

explanation.surface: A careless remark made during a dimly lit, saucy show.
explanation.walkthrough: An obiter dictum is a judge's remark said in passing, not binding.
explanation.definitionFit: A Latin legal term for an incidental remark, essentially a throwaway line.

clue.text: Athlete's spinning top penetrates part of camera

indicators.note: penetrates means goes into, so the twisted letters sit inside the camera part

parts.note: the shutter is part of a camera

indicators.note: spinning sends the three letters round into a new order

explanation.surface: An athlete's whirling top pokes into a camera.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spinning' scrambles the toy to give OTP, which 'penetrates' the camera part just after its first two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A shot-putter is an athlete who spins and hurls the heavy ball.

clue.text: Country left hanging after election?

explanation.surface: A nation whose fate hung in the balance after a vote.
explanation.walkthrough: In the disputed 2000 US election, partly punched ballot fragments were called hanging chads.
explanation.definitionFit: Chad is an African country; a chad is the paper bit punched from a ballot.

clue.text: Sign of arousal that doesn't begin to receive a response

indicators.note: the shortened word takes in the article
the word loses its opening letter

parts.note: an erection is a sign of arousal

explanation.surface: A response that fails to start a sign of excitement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that doesn't begin' cuts ERECTION to RECTION; 'to receive' puts A inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A reaction is a response to something.

clue.text: It goes on board with Muse endlessly holding Western Isle up

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the whole is read from bottom to top
the trimmed Muse holds the other pieces
endlessly drops the last letter

parts.note: Erato is the Muse of love poetry
Elba is the Mediterranean island of Napoleon's exile

explanation.surface: Something placed on the table with a Muse holding an island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' cuts ERATO to ERAT; 'holding' takes in W and ELBA, giving ERAWELBAT; 'up' reads it backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Tableware is dishes and cutlery set on the board, an old word for table.

clue.text: Influence going to the head of Lady Edna?

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

parts.note: Dame Edna Everage was Barry Humphries' comic character

explanation.surface: Influence enjoyed by the head of Lady Edna.
explanation.walkthrough: Dame Edna Everage was an Australian comedian's character; 'going to the' puts L at the front of her surname.
explanation.definitionFit: Leverage means power or influence to get things done.

clue.text: Way to spur on fish

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way
to spur on is to urge on

explanation.surface: A method of encouraging a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: The sturgeon is a large fish, the source of caviar.

clue.text: Born on brink of glitch

parts.note: a lip is an edge or brink

explanation.surface: Something born on the edge of a technical fault.
explanation.definitionFit: A blip is a minor temporary problem or glitch.

clue.text: Having gone out with a lady from New York

parts.note: broad is American slang for a woman

explanation.surface: Someone went out with a woman from New York.
explanation.definitionFit: Being abroad means having left, gone out of the country.

clue.text: Sound of brewing economic disaster dogs astronomer

indicators.note: dogs means follows close behind, so the disaster comes after the astronomer

parts.note: Edwin Hubble was an American astronomer
a bubble bursting is an economic disaster

explanation.surface: Economic collapse hounds a stargazer.
explanation.definitionFit: Hubble-bubble imitates the sound of bubbling liquid, as in a witch's brewing cauldron.

clue.text: Reported magician's skin ailment

indicators.note: reported means said aloud, so the word sounds like the magician

parts.note: David Blaine is an American illusionist

explanation.surface: Word of a magician suffering a skin complaint.
explanation.definitionFit: A blain is an old word for a blister or inflamed sore on the skin.

clue.text: Does it determine the predilection of Bishop Robinson?

definitions.text: Does it determine the predilection of Bishop Robinson?

parts.words: Does it determine the predilection of Bishop Robinson?
parts.note: a unit of heredity may shape one's tastes, and the first openly gay Episcopal bishop's first name

explanation.surface: Asking whether biology fixes a bishop's leanings.
explanation.walkthrough: Gene Robinson was the first openly gay bishop in the Episcopal Church.
explanation.definitionFit: A gene is a hereditary unit that may determine traits, and it is also the bishop's first name.

clue.text: Rescinded slapper's A levels

indicators.note: rescinded hints at drawing back, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: slapper is British slang for a promiscuous woman, a tart

explanation.surface: A loose woman's exam results are cancelled.
explanation.walkthrough: A levels are British school-leaving exams; here the A is a letter of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Strata are layers or levels, as of rock or society.

clue.text: Shed put off being a sinner?

parts.note: Shed is the setter, so I
to put off a task is to do it later

explanation.surface: The setter postponing something might count as sinning.
explanation.walkthrough: Setters often refer to themselves by name for I.
explanation.definitionFit: Worshipping idols is a sin in Biblical terms, so an idol-worshipper is a sinner.

clue.text: Boy competed impressively — but he was eclipsed by his sisters

definitions.text: he was eclipsed by his sisters

parts.note: ran means competed in a race
well means impressively

explanation.surface: A boy did well in a race, yet his sisters outshone him.
explanation.walkthrough: Branwell Brontë was overshadowed by his novelist sisters Charlotte, Emily and Anne.
explanation.definitionFit: The Brontë brother is famous mainly for being outshone by his literary sisters.

clue.text: Fuel ceases to function on railroad

parts.note: a machine that dies ceases to function
the El is the elevated railroad in Chicago or New York

explanation.surface: Fuel stops working on the railway.
explanation.definitionFit: Diesel is a type of fuel oil for engines.
